questions.question: Why is water is considered as a universal solvent?

  • any other solvent. This is due to its unique polar molecular structure, where the positive and
  • negative ends of water molecules can attract and pull apart other molecules or ions, allowing
  • them tobe dissolved.

  • negative ends of water molecules can attract and pull apart other molecules or ions, allowing
  • them tobe dissolved.
